usage: agentbreeder enable [-h] [--state-dir STATE_DIR] [--json]
                           [--environment ENVIRONMENT] [--stack DIR]
                           [--provider PROVIDER] [--ref REF]
                           target

positional arguments:
  target

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --json
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
                        The principal's environment (with --stack: the
                        stack's)
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
  --provider PROVIDER   Provider connection (with --ref)
  --ref REF             Principal reference (with --provider)
